name: ink-rooms
description: A monochrome 3D puzzle game with 48 rooms, built with Three.js.

scripts.validate: npm run test:puzzle && npm run typecheck:game && npm run build:game
scripts.test:puzzle: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-puzzle.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-elevation.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-machinery.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-design-quality.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-robots.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-robot-expansion.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-ice.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-ice-chapter.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-rotation.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-rotation-chapter.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-cube.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-cube-chapter.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-cube-view.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-cube-shell.ts
scripts.typecheck:game: tsc --noEmit --allowImportingTsExtensions --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck src/game.ts src/puzzle.ts src/hint-worker.ts
